title: devx SDK docs scratchpad - TODOs + notes
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick run-through before sprint sync

High level: focus today on clearing doc gaps in SDK quickstart and shipping a small sample app PR. Keep it lightweight: 1) fix auth snippet, 2) add streaming example, 3) link to hosted vs dedicated notes.

Open items (prioritized):
- [ ] Quickstart auth code is wrong for Node v3. Current snippet uses `RedwoodClient(apiKey)` which is outdated. Replace with `createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` and add note about env var and rotation. (owner: Ryan) ETA: EOD 2026-03-05
- [ ] Add streaming example to quickstart (Node + Python). Show both SDK stream API and raw HTTP SSE fallback. Short snippet only, link to full sample app. (owner: Samantha) ETA: 2026-03-06
- [ ] Sample app: small repo `examples/sdk-hello-stream` that demos chat streaming + reconnect logic + token count display. MVP: README, Node example, Python example. (owner: Mikaela) ETA: 2026-03-13 (can be later but want minimal PR this sprint)
- [ ] Docs: clarify rate limit / quota behavior for hosted vs dedicated in SDK docs. Add table with typical limits + how SDK handles 429 (exponential backoff). (owner: Ryan)
- [ ] Add note in SDK troubleshooting about mismatched model variant errors when routing/fallbacks happen (customers hit this when pinning versions). Link to platform rollout docs. (owner: Ryan)
- [ ] Tutorial fix: embeddings example currently uses `.embed()` method that doesn't exist in v2 — update to `client.embeddings.create({ model, input })`. Add small reranking example showing cosine similarity pseudo-code. (owner: Samantha)

Quick copy edits / nits:
- Remove outdated mention of `redwood-cli` from quickstart (we no longer require it).
- Add admonition about sending PII to hosted API and link to private deployment guide.
- Shorten the paragraph on throughput tuning; link to Optimize section instead of repeating details.

Notes to self / context:
- Customer on trial reported confusing sample app behavior: streaming stops after ~40s on Node sample. Hypothesis: missing keepalive on our SSE handler + client SDK didn't reattach. Reproduce locally.
- Revisit API sample for function calling — product wants structured output example with JSON schema and json_schema validation snippet. File a follow-up if time. (Jira DOCS-1245 already created)

Links / refs to copy into doc:
- GH PR to update quickstart: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/482 (draft)
- Confluence draft: DEVX SDK quickstart (confluence:DEVX-SDK-QUICKSTART-2026)
- Slack thread: #devx-docs "streaming snippet discussion" (link pinned in convo)

Small action log (today):
- 9:00 — repro streaming issue locally (run examples/streaming/node)
- 10:30 — sync with Samantha (10m) to align streaming snippet style
- 11:00 — push quickstart auth fix branch + small PR (title: docs: fix node auth snippet)
- 14:00 — review Mikaela's sample app outline, push README skeleton
- 16:00 — update embeddings example and open PR notes for DOCS-1245

Thoughts / TODO backlog (lower priority):
- Add short migration guide: v2 -> v3 SDK changes (auth, method names, streaming). Customers keep asking. Could be one-page.
- Expand sample apps list: include one that demonstrates private deployment config (how to set base_url and disable telemetry). This requires some platform docs input.
- Consider adding small checklist for reviewers: ensure code samples run with node 18+, python 3.10+, pin exact package version in examples to avoid drift.

Random notes / scratch: 
- Example credential rotation snippet: show `KMS + short-lived tokens` pattern for dedicated/private customers
- Remember to mention OpenTelemetry integration: trace spans for each request, env var REDWOOD_OTEL_ENDPOINT. Need to confirm key name with infra.

Next steps (tomorrow):
1) Merge quick auth fix PR, cut patch release of docs site if merged.
2) Add streaming short snippet and create examples repo skeleton.
3) Start a one-pager migration doc if I can finish before EOW.

-- end of scratchpad (will prune later into proper PR checklist)
